title: Ironforge
body: Ironforge is the ancient capital of the dwarves, carved deep into Ironforge Mountain above the snows of Dun Morogh. When the first dwarves came out of Uldaman, they raised an altar to the titan Khaz'goroth and built the Great Forge, and the city grew in rings of stone around its molten heart. King Magni Bronzebeard rules from the High Seat beside it. Since the fall of Gnomeregan, the exiled gnomes have made a home in Tinker Town, and in the Hall of Explorers the Explorers' League seeks proof that the dwarves were made by the titans.

parts.body: In recent years the draenei, exiles from another world, have joined the Alliance, and one of their farseers now teaches his people's shamans beside the Great Forge.

sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Ironforge (founding after leaving Uldaman, altar to Khaz'goroth and the Great Forge, city named for the forge, War of the Three Hammers, Second War siege held out, gnome refuge and Tinker Town, Deeprun Tram)

title: King Magni Bronzebeard
body: Magni Bronzebeard, eldest of three royal brothers, rules the dwarves of Khaz Modan. He held Ironforge through the Horde's siege in the Second War and pledged his people to the Alliance that freed Khaz Modan. Grief has followed him: when his brother Muradin was lost in Northrend, Magni poured his sorrow into forging the Ashbringer, and his daughter, Princess Moira, vanished in the Burning Steppes.

parts.body: Moira is alive, held under a spell by his old adversary, Emperor Dagran Thaurissan of the Dark Irons, and through her Thaurissan holds Ironforge at his mercy.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Magni_Bronzebeard (eldest of three brothers, Siege of Ironforge, Alliance pledge, Explorers' Guild, Ashbringer forged after Muradin's believed death, Moira)

parts.body: When Thaurissan fell, Moira mourned him and sent word that the heir to Ironforge would be a Dark Iron dwarf. Magni slumped into his throne, concluding that even in death, Thaurissan had won.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Magni_Bronzebeard (eldest of three brothers, Siege of Ironforge, Alliance pledge, Explorers' Guild, Ashbringer forged after Muradin's believed death, Moira)

parts.body: When the Scourge struck at the capitals on the eve of the war in Northrend, Magni swore by the honor of the Bronzebeards to find Muradin, crying out that his brother must still live.

sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Magni_Bronzebeard (eldest of three brothers, Siege of Ironforge, Alliance pledge, Explorers' Guild, Ashbringer forged after Muradin's believed death, Moira)

title: High Tinker Mekkatorque
body: Gelbin Mekkatorque won fame in Gnomeregan as an inventor, and the gnomes raised him to be High Tinker, leader of their people. When troggs broke into Gnomeregan, the radiation purge meant to save the city poisoned it instead. Mekkatorque led the survivors to Ironforge, and from Tinker Town he plans the day Gnomeregan will be retaken.

parts.body: The purge was not his idea. His trusted friend and chief advisor, Sicco Thermaplugg, urged it on him, and the High Tinker now names Thermaplugg the traitor who doomed Gnomeregan.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Gelbin_Mekkatorque (inventor, elected High Tinker, Thermaplugg chief advisor, trogg invasion, gas killed about eighty percent, refuge in Ironforge, Tinker Town)

parts.body: Thermaplugg has been slain in the depths of Gnomeregan, and the High Tinker likes to imagine that the last thing through the traitor's head was a boot.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Gelbin_Mekkatorque (inventor, elected High Tinker, Thermaplugg chief advisor, trogg invasion, gas killed about eighty percent, refuge in Ironforge, Tinker Town)

parts.body: On the eve of the war in Northrend a holy artifact of the naaru's Light came to Tinker Town, and Mekkatorque dreamed of a device to destroy the Scourge with a single pull of a lever.

sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Gelbin_Mekkatorque (inventor, elected High Tinker, Thermaplugg chief advisor, trogg invasion, gas killed about eighty percent, refuge in Ironforge, Tinker Town)
